title: Providing for Geographic Subdivision of Existing Subject Headings
summary: A heading may be divided by place only when its authority record has value i in 008/06, displayed as (May Subd Geog). Describes the proposal procedure to authorize geographic subdivision for an existing heading: retrieve the record, select May Subd Geog, add a 952 count of bib records to change (0 allowed), save, and submit PDFs to PTCP.
validation_rules: A subject heading may be followed by a geographic subdivision ($z) only if its authority record has value `i` in 008/06, shown as `(May Subd Geog)`; a $z directly after a heading lacking this authorization is invalid until a proposal is approved. (H 194 Background)
Corporate body name headings divided by place follow H 475; general authorization rules are in H 364. (H 194 Background)

[LC practice] A proposal to authorize geographic subdivision selects the May Subd Geog value and includes `952 ## $a Bib. records to be changed: N` (N may be 0); attaching bib records is optional. (H 194 sec. 2, 3)

sections.heading: 1. Retrieving the heading in the Subject Heading Proposal System
sections.text: In order to divide by place a subject heading that is not currently authorized for geographic subdivision, retrieve the heading in the Subject Heading Proposal System. Click on the icon to the right of the heading in the browse display, and in the dropdown menu click Propose a change to this record.

sections.heading: 2. Changing the 008 field
sections.text: To permit the subject heading to be divided by place, select the May Subd Geog radio button.

sections.heading: 3. Bibliographic file maintenance
sections.text:
Add a 952 field showing the number of bibliographic records that are being submitted to be changed if the proposal is approved. Format the field as in the following example:

```
952 ## $a Bib. records to be changed: 5
```

If no records are submitted, indicate Bib. records to be changed: 0.

Note: Searching the LC Database to locate and print out existing bibliographic records in which the heading could be divided by place is an optional procedure. Proposals to divide a heading by place may be submitted with no accompanying bibliographic records.

sections.heading: 4. Saving and viewing the record
sections.text: Save the proposed revision to the Subject Heading Proposal System by clicking on the wrench icon in the upper right-hand corner to reveal the Tools menu and clicking the Save button. The proposed revision is now searchable within the system. Search for the proposed heading in the browse display. The text of the heading is displayed in brown, indicating that it is a proposed revision and not yet approved.

sections.heading: 5. Submitting the proposal
sections.text: Make a PDF of the revised authority record for the heading that is being changed as well as PDFs of all related authority records that were revised in conjunction with the proposal. Submit the PDFs to the Policy, Training, and Cooperative Programs Division according to the instructions in H 200 sec. 19. Once these PDFs have been submitted to PTCP, make no further changes to the online authority records in the Subject Heading Proposal System. If any further additions or changes are required, notify PTCP by telephone, email, or inter-office mail.
